empty.heading: No environments yet
empty.body: Add a swarm or a standalone Docker host. TierPlan gives you one command that installs a small agent on it. The host needs no open inbound port.
empty.noPermission: Ask an admin to add an environment.

localHost.loadFailed: Couldn't look for a Docker socket.

detected.heading: Manage this Docker host?
detected.body: TierPlan found Docker on {{name}} and can manage it through the socket.

localHost.notice: Managing a host through the Docker socket gives TierPlan, and any admin who signs in here, root-equivalent control of that host.

swarm.heading: Add this swarm?
swarm.body: TierPlan found Docker on {{name}}. This host is part of a swarm. TierPlan manages a swarm through an agent on each node, so every stack is listed once.
swarm.workerHint: This host is a worker. Run the install command on a manager node, because a worker can't create services.

swarmAdded.heading: This swarm is already added
swarmAdded.bodyOffered: {{swarm}} manages this swarm. Fold this host into it so TierPlan reaches this node through the socket.
swarmAdded.bodyWaiting: {{swarm}} manages this swarm. TierPlan is waiting for its agents to list this node.

notReady.heading: This node isn't ready
notReady.body: Docker says this node is joining or leaving a swarm. Wait for that to finish, then check again.

unsupported.body: {{engine}} {{version}} (API {{api}}) isn't supported. TierPlan needs Docker Engine 24 or later.
unsupported.podman: Podman {{version}} detected. TierPlan manages Docker Engine only.
unsupported.addHelper: It will appear as unsupported, with no operations available.
unsupported.swarm: This host is part of a swarm, so TierPlan doesn't add it as its own environment.

unreachable.heading: Docker isn't answering
unreachable.body: TierPlan found a Docker socket at {{path}}, but Docker didn't answer. Check that Docker is running and that TierPlan is allowed to open the socket, then check again.

notDetected.heading: No Docker socket found
notDetected.body: TierPlan didn't find a Docker socket at {{path}}. To manage this host, start TierPlan with the socket mounted:
notDetected.footnote: You can add remote hosts and swarms after setup from Environments.
